name: scrapline
description: Scrapline — browser jetpack shooter with RL env (walking skeleton)

scripts.build: npm run build:client && tsc -b && npm run build --workspace=@scrapline/env && node tools/stage-dist.js
scripts.test: npm run build:client && npm run build && vitest run packages/core packages/client packages/env && node --test tests/skeleton.test.js tests/stage-dist.test.js tests/core-imports.test.js tests/perf-guardrail.test.js
